summary: This component renders a page displaying all blog posts that belong to a specific series. It extracts the series name from the URL, loads the matching posts and series metadata, applies themed colors if available, and displays the posts in a grid with a hero section—or shows an error message if the series doesn't exist or has no posts.

explanations.18: matchPath is checking if the current URL matches the pattern '/series/:slug' and extracting the slug parameter from it, similar to how a router identifies which page you're on.
explanations.22: This safely grabs the slug value from the matched URL pattern, using optional chaining (?.) so it returns undefined if nothing matched.
explanations.40: This filters the full blog post list down to only posts that have a series property and whose series name (converted to a URL-safe format) matches the one from the URL.
explanations.48: This gets the series name from the first filtered post, or falls back to the slug from the URL if the list is empty—the comment explains it ensures we always have a string for display.
explanations.52: This conditionally creates a style object with CSS custom properties for accent colors only if the series has a defined color; if there's no color, heroStyle stays undefined.
explanations.62: This sorts the posts from newest to oldest by converting their date strings to milliseconds and comparing them numerically.
explanations.78: This checks if there are any posts in the series before rendering the image, to avoid showing a hero image when there's nothing to display.
explanations.100: This uses a plain HTML anchor tag instead of Docusaurus's Link component because this page is generated by a build plugin and isn't a registered route that Link can navigate to.
